interpretation: These are earliest feasible fixed-duration candidates under the stated filter, not a schedule and not a solution to the full SatNet problem. Review the restrictions and candidate counts before accepting the project model.
filter: exactly one resource option, containing exactly one antenna
exactly one visibility period for that antenna
communication interval fits within the request window and TRX ON/OFF window
complete activity including setup and teardown does not overlap antenna maintenance
important_modeling_note: The audit models setup/teardown as part of antenna occupancy, while only the communication interval must fit within the TRX ON/OFF visibility period. It uses the earliest feasible transmission start. The source benchmark's full objective is not optimized by this audit.
